item.description:
Hidden Content:

Billed only as Lainey Wilson & Friends, this was another secondary market crash. The floor was all tables and chairs and 4 figures and up for the high rollers and only slight less expensive balcony tickets for the general public. In the days before the show they were trading far below the break even point and bottomed out around $20 right before showtime. Surprised to find the friends were Jelly Roll, Lukas Nelson and John Mayer. Not sure why Jelly Roll is so hated as he is really funny and personable. They were trading off in a circle on acoustic guitars. It really did feel friends hanging out with their guitars in a living room. I really hate recording acoustic events and if I had known I might have passed but I was lucky to get a good spot and this was a really special show. There are a lot of separately indexed non-music tracks that are worth playing thru at least once to get a feeling for the vibe that night.
